Story (I want / I must): I want to ask questions about the practice (opening hours, repeat prescriptions, registration)
So that: I get accurate answers without phoning
Acceptance criteria:
- Answers come only from the approved knowledge base
- Every answer cites the source document and section
- If no source is found, the agent says it does not know and gives the practice phone number
- Answers are in plain English and at most 120 words

Story (I want / I must): I want to book, move or cancel a GP appointment in the chat
So that: I do not have to wait on the phone
Acceptance criteria:
- Shows free slots from the appointment service (mock API for now)
- Confirms date, time and clinician before booking
- Patient can reschedule or cancel an existing booking
- Each action is written to the audit log with a timestamp and booking id

Story (I want / I must): I must make the assistant refuse medical advice and send urgent cases to NHS 111 or 999
So that: patients are never put at risk
Acceptance criteria:
- Questions about symptoms, diagnosis or medication doses are refused politely
- Red-flag words (chest pain, can't breathe, suicidal, etc.) trigger a 999 or NHS 111 message straight away
- Refusals use a fixed, approved wording
- Every refusal and escalation is logged

Story (I want / I must): I must have personal data removed from chat logs
Acceptance criteria:
- NHS number, name, date of birth, address, phone and e-mail are masked before anything is logged
- Unit tests cover each data type with UK formats
- Raw chat text is not stored beyond the session
- Log retention follows the record retention schedule

Story (I want / I must): I want a structured summary of my consultation notes
So that: I spend less time on admin
Acceptance criteria:
- Output sections: Presenting complaint, History, Examination, Plan, Follow-up
- Each summary line links back to the source note line it came from
- Nothing appears in the summary that is not in the notes (faithfulness check)
- Works on notes up to 3,000 words

Story (I want / I must): I must review, edit and approve a summary before it is saved
So that: the record is always clinically checked
Acceptance criteria:
- Summary is shown as an editable draft
- It can only be saved after the clinician clicks Approve
- The approver's id and the time are recorded
- A rejected draft is discarded and not stored

Story (I want / I must): I want the assistant to flag gaps in the notes
So that: I can fill them in rather than have them guessed
Acceptance criteria:
- Missing sections are marked Not recorded instead of being filled in
- Ambiguous medication or dose text is highlighted for review
- Flags are listed at the top of the draft

Story (I want / I must): I must have every summary action audited
So that: we can show who did what and when
Acceptance criteria:
- Log entries for generated, edited, approved and rejected
- Each entry records user id, time, model version and policy version
- Log entries contain no clinical text
- An audit report can be exported as CSV

Story (I want / I must): I want a referral letter drafted from the approved summary
Acceptance criteria:
- Uses the practice referral template (header, reason, history, medication, request)
- Fills fields only from the approved summary
- Fields with no data are left as [To complete] for the clinician
- Draft is ready in under 10 seconds

Story (I want / I must): I must edit and sign off the letter before it is sent
So that: I stay responsible for its content
Acceptance criteria:
- Letter cannot be exported or sent until signed off
- Sign-off records clinician id and time
- Edits after sign-off need a new sign-off

Story (I want / I must): I want a version of my referral letter I can understand
Acceptance criteria:
- Patient copy is written at reading age 11 or below
- Medical terms are explained in brackets
- Says what happens next and who to contact
- Clinician approves the patient copy separately

Story (I want / I must): I want an accessible copy of my referral letter
So that: I can read it with assistive technology
Acceptance criteria:
- Export as accessible PDF and HTML meeting WCAG 2.2 AA
- Large-print option (at least 16pt)
- Passes an automated accessibility check in CI
